notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content: - （Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed the bug where the Dark Heart in the hidden area in Sunset Mountain could disappear if you ignored it. \[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where achievement progress was not properly recorded in the demo version. (Due to the technical issue, it can't be fixed if you had already played the demo, so please re-unlock them. I apologize for the inconvenience.)

- （Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed the bug where fighting certain boss in training room after game clear could cause inconsistency in the number of Dark Hearts or trigger unintended story events.\[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
-（Spoiler alert）\[spoiler]  Fixed a bug where the branching condition for "High Difficulty Action" and the trigger for the preceding warning message were inconsistent.\[/spoiler]

- （Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed a bug where the forced battle near the end of Celestial Sea in the high-difficulty route could end earlier.\[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
・Fixed a crash that could occur when Colin redraws her hand during the card game.

・Fixed an issue where progress for “Colin Bomb exp.” objective in the Colin Fan Club was not displayed correctly.

・（Japanese）Corrected a typo.

・（English）Adjusted line breaks.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if Hime went first in the card game (again).

- （Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed the bug where the balls disappear a bit earlier in the Sunset Mountain part of Final Performance. (Difficulty ★★★★)\[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if Hime went first in the card game.

- Corrected a error in map of Greenfield.

- Fixed an issue where the “Notebook Updated” message would incorrectly appear under certain conditions upon entering the upper-right room in Greenfield.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where achievements would not unlock if the Steam Overlay was disabled.

-（Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed the progression-blocking bug that occurred when acquiring items during the event, after you "skipped the collection".\[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4
notes.content: Fixed some bugs, adjusted the game balance, and refined the level design.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3
notes.content:
-Removed the restriction preventing the game from transitioning to the title screen until the frame rate stabilized.
-Added the option to visualize current frame rate.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2
notes.content:
-Fixed a fatal bug that you encounter at Ja's House.
-Added the option to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.
